notes: Audited against data/bill-text/119-HR-2600.txt (Introduced in House, IH; 6,781 chars; full read). No referencedSources registered on the analysis; versionChanges reports Introduced->Engrossed unchanged, so IH text governs the substance. ZERO material findings. The substantive prose (summary, brief, top_lines, sections[1].items[0].main/detail, changes.added, gaps) is faithful: program creation (new 51 U.S.C. 60307 in Chapter 603 of title 51), Earth Science Division siting, acquire/disseminate cost-effective commercial Earth remote sensing data/imagery, scientific/operational/educational purposes, publication-for-scientific-purposes protection (60307(b)), discretionary license-term authority (60307(c)), US-vendor priority 'to the maximum extent practicable' (60307(d)), and the 180-day-then-annual report to Senate Commerce + House Science listing agreements/vendors/license terms/uses (60307(c) Report) all verify verbatim. Year 2019 (pilot) and pilot-'success' finding are both sourced. No figure, entity, direction-inversion, or attribution errors found. 'permanent' is not a source word but is a fair reading of codification into title 51 with no sunset. Minor issues only: (1) likelihoodReason carries the usual extrinsic procedural/framing content -- '6 cosponsors', 'passed the House', 'placed on the Senate Legislative Calendar' (all corroborated by votes[]/versions[] metadata, not the IH text), and 'bipartisan and low-cost' / 'favors Senate passage' (unsourced breadth-of-support and predictive framing, rubric class 8); the 'successful pilot' clause IS sourced (Finding 4A). (2) Three minor omissions: the 60307(c)(3) National Academies decadal-survey reporting element, the 180-day initial-report deadline, and the 60307(b)(2) derived/enhanced-data publication protection. Stage/vote/prose consistent (stage 'Passed House' matches House Voice Vote Passed 2026-02-23; analyzedAt 2026-06-15 is newer than stageDate 2026-02-24, so no freshness gap). sourceStart/sourceEnd left null per task; every non-empty sourceSpan is a verbatim single-line substring of the source (empty spans on the 5 metadata/framing rows). auditModel opus; no cross-model verify run (verifyModel null).
